purpose: Evaluator-only definitions for exactly five matched A/B pairs; never index or send expected answers to either model.
status: Prepared before official runs; runtime harness must record freeze hash and actual evidence provenance.
architecture_A: Same prior-module pipeline and judge, without automatic correction; CORREGIR escalates.
architecture_B: Same pipeline and judge, with at most two corrections using unchanged original context and evidence.

protocol.matching: Use identical query, validated seeded context and source version for each A/B pair. Isolate runtime session IDs to prevent one run teaching the other. Record actual retrieved evidence; disclose differences if retrieval is not identical.
protocol.memory_setup: Seed only the supplied synthetic context for M8-02 through the normal memory interface; record the seed operation separately from measured runs. Other cases start with empty memory. Do not feed expected answers into memory.
protocol.scoring: Independent evaluator checks final released answer against required and forbidden claims; model judge score is not ground truth. A withheld/escalated answer to an answerable case is not counted correct merely because it is safe. No replacement runs or best-of sampling.
protocol.cost: Collect usage for every included model invocation, including router, agent tool iterations, writer, judge and corrections. Record pricing date/currency/scope for calculated estimates. Missing usage is unknown, never zero. Report non-model services separately when unmeasured.
protocol.effects: No CRM writes, outbound messages, drafts, voice synthesis or Telegram sends during the ten official comparison runs. Required live escalation routing is verified separately.
